skills.name: start_task
skills.description: Start a background task with 1-30 filesystem steps. Inspect relevant paths first. plan_json is a JSON array of objects with tool and args. Supported tools: make_directory, write_file, append_file, edit_file, copy_path, move_path, trash_path. The response contains a task id for progress and cancellation.

description.description: Short description of the user's requested task.

plan_json.description: JSON array such as [{"tool":"make_directory","args":{"path":"/home/user/Sorted"}}]. Each step must use exact filesystem skill arguments.

skills.name: task_status
skills.description: Get progress and per-step results for a background task by its id.

skills.name: list_tasks
skills.description: List current and recently completed background tasks and their progress.

skills.name: cancel_task
skills.description: Request cancellation of a background task; the current file operation may finish, then remaining steps stop.
